lines.text: After crossing the Jordan, Israel is to set up plastered stones on Mount Ebal and write the law on them.
Israel is to build an altar of uncut stones on Mount Sinai and offer burnt offerings on it.
Moses and the Levitical priests tell Israel to be silent and listen, because they have become the LORD's people.
Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin stand on Mount Gerizim to bless, while six tribes including Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali stand on Mount Ebal to curse.
The Levites proclaim the curses in a loud voice, and all the people answer each one with Hallelujah.
